purpose: Implement safe checkpoint resumption preventing redundant step execution

tasks.title: Implement ResumeTaskWorkflow
tasks.context: Agent workflows interrupted by timeouts or user intervention must resume cleanly from the last completed step.
tasks.why: Prevent redundant work and duplicate side effects.

references.excerpt: func ResumeTaskWorkflow(cp *Checkpoint, steps []StepDefinition, runner StepRunner) (*Checkpoint, error)

decisions.chosen: Linear iteration with set-based completed step lookup
decisions.rationale: O(1) skip checks and deterministic execution order.
rejected: Re-executing all steps idempotently (not all steps are idempotent)

steps.action: Index cp.CompletedSteps into a fast lookup map
steps.expected: Set of already completed step IDs created

steps.action: Iterate steps. If in set, skip runner call. If not in set, set CurrentStep and call runner.Execute
steps.expected: Completed steps skipped, remaining steps executed

steps.action: On step error, record LastError and return immediately without running next steps
steps.expected: Halt on failure with accurate checkpoint state

interfaces: func ResumeTaskWorkflow(cp *Checkpoint, steps []StepDefinition, runner StepRunner) (*Checkpoint, error)
constraints: Already completed steps must not trigger runner.Execute
Failed step must not be added to CompletedSteps

examples.output: runner called only for S2, final CompletedSteps=[S1, S2]

stop_conditions: Any step failure must halt execution and preserve partial progress

acceptance.requirement: Completed steps in checkpoint are skipped without re-execution
acceptance.expected: Runner called only for remaining uncompleted steps

acceptance.requirement: Step failure records error in checkpoint and prevents further execution
acceptance.expected: Returns error, checkpoint records step 1 completed and step 2 failure, step 3 never runs
